'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Chris Wirfs DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Wirfs]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Unleashed.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
